stories.title: Rep. Massie forces a House vote to impeach Defense Secretary Hegseth over Iran war conduct
stories.reason: Massie's eight-article resolution, filed as privileged and forcing a House vote within two days, accuses Hegseth of violating the War Powers Resolution over Iran and unauthorized operations in Venezuela and Yemen, putting Republicans on the record even though the effort faces near-certain defeat.

stories.title: Global democracy report finds US democratic performance at its lowest point in 50 years of measurement
stories.reason: International IDEA's annual assessment found declines in nearly half of the 30 indicators it tracks for the US, citing Trump's amassing of executive power and retaliation against perceived enemies, part of a broader global pattern of eroding freedom of expression and rule of law.

stories.title: CLARITY Act crypto bill fails crucial Senate cloture vote, falling short 49-50
stories.reason: Four Republicans joined all Democrats in blocking the bill even after ethics revisions addressing concerns about officials profiting from crypto, likely pushing comprehensive digital-asset regulation into next year.

stories.title: Bank of Japan raises its policy rate to 1.25%, the highest since 1995, in a split 7-2 vote
stories.reason: Two board members dissented as the BOJ cited rising risk that inflation will overshoot its 2% target, marking a quickening tightening cycle that took just three months since its last hike compared with six months previously.

stories.title: UN General Assembly's high-level week opens in New York as world leaders gather under a 'restoring trust' theme
stories.reason: The debate running through September 28, presided over by Bangladesh's Dr. Khalilur Rahman, arrives as the Iran war, Gaza conflict and a global democratic recession test whether the UN can still deliver on its founding promises.

stories.title: Netanyahu set to meet Rubio, not Trump, at the UN amid Gaza and Qatar talks
stories.reason: The apparent snub -- with Israel's PMO saying the schedule isn't finalized -- comes as Washington works to manage fallout from Israel's botched strike on Hamas leaders in Doha and ongoing ceasefire mechanics.

stories.title: OpenAI's Astra model rolls out broadly to paid plans this week after a controversial launch
stories.reason: Billed as OpenAI's most capable model for computer and browser use, Astra's wider release follows a launch already tangled in the Millennium Prize credit dispute and this month's industry-wide fight over AI safety pacing.

stories.title: Sudan's civil war has now displaced over 14 million people and killed more than 150,000
stories.reason: With two-thirds of Sudan's population -- 33.7 million people -- now needing humanitarian aid and rising tensions between Sudan and neighbors Chad and Ethiopia, the war remains the world's largest displacement crisis even as international attention stays fixed elsewhere.
